title: Mini Crème Brulee Honey Infused Hair Perfume

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Mist & Hair Mist > Women > Fragrance

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ All Hair Types✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Increases Shine
What it is: An irresistible hair perfume, infused with Mirsalehi Honey, to add shine and instantly scent hair with notes of brown sugar, whipped cream, and vanilla.

Hair Texture: Straight, Wavy, Curly, and Coily

Hair Type: Fine, Medium, and Thick

Hair Concerns:
- Dryness
- Shine

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mirsalehi Honey: Maintains a natural moisture balance for strong, shiny, and healthy-looking hair.
- Argan Oil: Nourishes, hydrates, and adds healthy-looking shine.

What Else You Need to Know: Discover Gisou Honey Infused Hair Perfume in our limited-edition gourmand scent, Crème Brûlée. Enriched with Mirsalehi Honey and argan oil, it hydrates, adds shine
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Spray, shake, and shine!
-Divide hair into sections and spray evenly from an arm’s length distance throughout the hair. -Give your hair a flip to diffuse the irresistible scent.
-Hair is hydrated, scented, and has a glossy shine.
Ingredients+
-Mirsalehi Honey: Maintains a natural moisture balance for strong, shiny, and healthy-looking hair.
-Argan Oil: Nourishes, hydrates, and adds healthy-looking shine.

Alcohol Denat., Aqua (Water, Eau), Parfum (Fragrance), PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Mel (Honey, Miel)*, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Tris(Tetramethylhydroxypiperidinol) Citrate, Benzotriazolyl Dodecyl p-Cresol, t-Butyl Alcohol, Denatonium Benzoate, Benzyl Benzoate**, Benzyl Cinnamate**, Isoeugenol**, Rose Ketones**, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes**, Vanillin**, CI 19140 (Yellow 5), CI 14700 (Red 4).
